definition: First-year cohort re-enrollment rate the following fall.
formula: count(cohort enrolled in Y+1) / count(first-time first-year in cohort Y)
hidden_rule: Exclude transfer students (is_transfer = true) from the cohort denominator.

definition: Of admitted applicants, the share who matriculate (enroll).
formula: count(applications where enrolled = true) / count(applications where decision = 'admitted')

definition: Of funds received in a fiscal year, the share retained (not disbursed).
formula: sum(amount where txn_type = 'retained') / sum(amount where txn_type = 'inflow') over the fiscal year
hidden_rule: The fiscal year is July 1 - June 30, not the calendar year; filter by the fiscal calendar.

definition: Return rate on invested principal over a period.
hidden_rule: Only realized returns count (is_realized = true); exclude unrealized gains.
